name: baex-framework
description: browser api extended with wasm for electron with tailwindcss
author: naranyala

scripts.dev:electron: bun run build:wasm && bun x vite
scripts.build:native: cd rust-native/db-core && cargo build --release && cp target/release/libdb_core.so index.node
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build rust-wasm --target web && wasm-pack build rust-utils/math-utils --target web && wasm-pack build rust-utils/string-utils --target web
scripts.build: bun run build:native && bun run build:wasm && bun x tsc && bun x vite build && bun x electron-builder
